lead_independence.headline: Voluntary Rockridge evacuation ordered; St. Lucie County schools to close
lead_independence.lead: Flooding that forced Nov. 3 polling-place changes in Indian River and St. Lucie counties and prompted Tuesday closures of St. Lucie County public schools, county offices and courthouses has now led to a voluntary evacuation in Rockridge. The Indian River County Sheriff's Office announced the evacuation Monday night because of flooding and potential wastewater backups.

lead_independence.headline: Flooding closes Port St. Lucie roads, suspends St. Lucie County's regular ART service
lead_independence.lead: Flooding forced road closures in Port St. Lucie and temporarily suspended St. Lucie County's regular Area Regional Transit (ART) service Monday as officials urged residents to avoid unnecessary travel. The county activated its Emergency Operations Center and issued a local state of emergency as crews responded to widespread flooding and unsafe driving conditions.
